About

Strategy-first, performance-driven.

I'm a Strategic Marketing & Content Strategy Consultant with over 7 years of experience building and scaling brands across fashion, hospitality, education, logistics, medical and pharmaceutical services.

My approach begins with deep business analysis, competitor research, audience profiling and KPI definition aligned with clear business objectives — never guesswork. Every engagement starts with strategy, not a content calendar.

From there, I build structured marketing systems that combine positioning, content architecture, campaign planning and continuous performance optimization — resulting in measurable growth in awareness, engagement and sales.

I supervise execution and guide creative direction so every piece of content serves a business purpose. I don't chase short-term campaigns — I build growth systems that compound.

Content Strategy & Creation

I don't just write content. I build the system behind it.

Every content piece I produce is part of a business strategy — never a stand-alone post. Before a single caption is written, I've already mapped the audience, aligned on business goals, and defined the content pillars that piece needs to serve.

From there, I build editorial plans, monthly content calendars and campaign messaging that carry a brand's voice consistently — across educational content, sales content and storytelling — and I supervise designers and execution teams to make sure creative work matches the strategy on paper.

The result: content that reads as spontaneous but is built on research, positioning and a defined business purpose.

Flagship Case Studies

Transformation, not activities

Two engagements broken down in full — from the business challenge through to measurable results.

Ablaze Scarves

Fashion — Scarves & Accessories
Visit Client

Challenge

The brand was attracting the wrong audience and relying almost entirely on direct sales content, which capped both reach and sales quality.

Objectives

  • Reach the ideal audience
  • Increase sales
  • Strengthen brand positioning
  • Improve content quality

Strategic Thinking

  • Brand repositioning around a clearer identity
  • Audience research and refinement
  • A content strategy built to earn attention, not just sell
  • Ongoing business development support

Execution — My Role & Scope

  • Monthly content plans and editorial calendar
  • Educational, sales, lifestyle and behind-the-scenes content
  • Copywriting, creative direction and design supervision
  • Team coordination from strategy through to publish
100%+Sales Growth
↑ SignificantReach Increase
↑Follower Growth
StrongerBrand Positioning

Key takeaway — repositioning the brand and refining the audience before scaling content is what turned a sales-only page into a brand people actively followed for its content.

MAK Pharma

Pharmaceutical — Medical & Educational Marketing
Visit Client

Challenge

As a pharmaceutical brand, MAK Pharma needed to build trust and product awareness in a category where overselling erodes credibility — without relying on paid media.

Objectives

  • Build organic product awareness
  • Strengthen product positioning
  • Educate the audience credibly
  • Grow reach without paid support

Strategic Thinking

  • Educational-first marketing over direct promotion
  • Medical copywriting grounded in accuracy and trust
  • Campaign planning built for organic distribution
  • Consistent product positioning across every post

Execution — My Role & Scope

  • Educational content series and campaign planning
  • Medical copywriting for each product line
  • Creative direction across every release
  • Full ownership from strategy to execution
3XOrganic Reach
0Paid Advertising Used
100%Organic Growth

Key takeaway — the 3X organic reach growth was achieved entirely without paid advertising, driven by educational content built on trust rather than promotion.

Elharefa is not just a platform; but a full integrated platform & community for freelancers & remote job seekers in the MENA region.

The origin of the word Elharefa: Elharefa are the professionals — in the Egyptian slang. Built to gather exceptional professionals into a network where they can add value to others through their top-notch talents.

Elharefa.com is a talents marketplace platform & community connecting freelancers and remote job seekers with clients who want to hire trusted, vetted professionals.

ما هى سمات الجسم الكمثرى (قالب المثلث)؟ فيه تكون الأرداف و الجناب أعرض من الكتف و محيط الصدر، و الوسط محدد و ضيق مقارنة بالأرداف.

نصائح لارتداء الملابس التي تتناسب مع الجسم الكمثرى: اختاري الملابس التى تصنع التوازن بين مناطق الجسم المختلفة، و اعتمدي على الخطوط التى تأخذ تركيز العين فتعطي إحساسًا بالطول، و الألوان الفاتحة و الأقمشة المنقوشة أكثر من الألوان الداكنة السادة.
